title: Nutty Nice Chaozhou Noodles Chow-Fun
description: A lazy Sunday dish from the Chaozhou region of China, featuring snappy noodles, a sweet and savory sauce, and a crunchy topping. Perfect for a comforting and filling meal.
instructions: Heat vegetable oil in a wok or large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add dried shrimp and stir-fry until fragrant, about 1 minute.
Add mushrooms and stir-fry until they release their liquid and start to brown, about 3-4 minutes.
Add Namul-Blanch-Season Mix according to package instructions.
Stir in soy sauce and apricot jam to create a sweet and savory sauce.
Add rice noodles to the wok or skillet and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes, until they are well coated with the sauce.
Transfer the noodles to a serving dish and garnish with toasted nuts, scallions, and a drizzle of sesame oil.
If using dried shrimp, rehydrate them by soaking them in water for 5-10 minutes before using.
Adjust the amount of soy sauce and apricot jam to taste.
